small_sample_limitation_discussion: The evaluation is conducted on N=10 subjects from PhysioNet. While paired t-test (p=0.0387) and Wilcoxon signed-rank test (p=0.0423) both achieve p < 0.05, small sample sizes can exhibit higher variance in effect size estimation. Broad multi-center replication on larger clinical cohorts is recommended to confirm population-wide generalization.
